newsitem.title: USA: Helm to sell Interpak units to Katoen Natie.
newsitem.headline: Helm to sell Interpak units to Katoen Natie.

text.p: Helm Resources Inc said Friday that its subsidiary, Interpak Holdings Inc, has signed a letter of intent to sell its Interpak Terminals units, located in Houston and Edison, N.J. to Katoen Natie N.V., a privately-held Belgian corporation, for an undisclosed cash purchase price.

The sale is subject to approval of the parties' respective boards of directors and the negotiation and execution of a definitive purchase agreement. Helm said it expects to close the sale in the next 30 to 60 days.

Interpak is a provider of custom packaging and distribution services to manufacturers of thermoplastic resins. In 1996 it had revenues of $18.1 million, which, said Helm, constitutes substantially all of its revenues.
The company said it intends to refocus its efforts in the financial services area, and already has interests in a factoring company and a mezzanine finance company.
